_notes: Mini-pilot config, design of EMIR 3 (2026-10-07, task #73; before any data). prereg_approved stays false until the user approves prereg_minipilot.md: until then no real run (also --resume) starts; dry runs work. Models: deepseek-v4.1-flash, mistral-large-4-0, gpt-6-luna. providers: tag / provider_name from GET /api/v1/models/{id}/endpoints, checked 2026-10-06 (deepinfra/fp8 = DeepInfra fp8, as in pilot v2; mistral = Mistral; openai = OpenAI); allow_fallbacks false and require_parameters true for all three (pgg_game.provider_routing). temperature and reasoning_effort are not sent (logged "default"). Frames (EMIR 3 Part 1): abstract_v3 = deepseek, mistral, gpt; story = deepseek, gpt. Mistral plays only abstract_v3 (its suitability for the main experiment, E3, is measured in the main frame); the frame comparison abstract_v3 / story is made within DeepSeek and GPT. Calls (accepted answers, re-requests not included): deepseek 1200, gpt 1200, mistral 600, total 3000. frame_files lock each file by sha256 (another file stops the real run and the dry run). story = frames/story_A.json (draft A, the jar). Every frame file declares kind; the frame linter (forbidden roots of cerceve_linter) runs on every frame at every run start except a frame of kind abstract (abstract_v3 is exempt, story_A is linted); the verdict per frame goes to every segment entry (frame_audit). comprehension = the two rule-comprehension questions of each frame; q2 ends 'Give the change as a whole number (it can be positive, zero or negative).' (EMIR 3 3b), answer key 28 / -6. A rule-comprehension call does not stop the run: when max_invalid is used up its row says comp_missing and the game goes on; its invalids are counted apart (n_comp_invalid, n_comp_parse_fail, n_comp_missing per model) and are not in the decisions' invalid-rate cap (invalid_rate_cap 0.05 of the planned decision calls); their cost is in the budget. cards: cards/pilot_cards_v3.json locked by cards_sha256 (another file stops the run and the dry run); Boston + Riyadh = 6 cards, styles minimal / value / factual. Relative paths are relative to the code directory. Budget (EMIR 3 Part 2): budget_usd = 10 is the hard cap on accumulated usage.cost; model_budget_usd = per-model caps (mistral 5, deepseek 5, gpt 0.5 USD): a model over its cap stops alone and is reported, the others go on. expected_cost_gate_usd = 4.5 on the mean dry-run estimate: above it no real run starts and the overrun is reported; no arm is dropped. reasoning_cap_rule: Mistral's reasoning_capped is max(reasoning_tokens, completion_tokens) >= max_tokens - 4096 (EMIR 3 3a; in M1, 11 of 18 responses had reasoning_tokens > completion_tokens); the other models keep reasoning_tokens >= max_tokens - 4096; rows and summaries show both numbers; cost is priced from completion_tokens. snapshot_version_models = [mistral]: check_snapshot compares Mistral's model_version (the dated model of the serving endpoint); a response without it is only counted (n_model_version_unknown), not re-requested. A response of a pinned model without a provider name is re-requested and counted (n_provider_mismatch, n_provider_missing). run: the template minipilot_{run_date} gets the local date of the run start (YYYYMMDD) for a new run; --resume needs the resolved name with --run. runs_dir must exist; outputs go to runs_dir/<run>/. isolated_round_no = 5 ('This is round 5 of 10.', isolated_frame fixed_round). rationale, max_invalid (3), invalid_rate_cap, stop_on_length, workers (4), parallel_units (3), check_snapshot and seed_namespace (pgg-minipilot): prereg_minipilot.md settings table.
